annotations.title: Set the ad account spending limit

description:
[writes · `ads:spend` scope] Sets the Meta ad account spending limit, in the account currency (e.g. 800 = $800). Removing the limit (null) always needs the owner. Inside the owner's agent ceiling it is applied at once; above it the result is `approval_requested`: tell the user the owner has an approval request in Ads > Agent activity, and repeat the same call once they approve. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/accounts/spend-limit.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

spendCap.description: The new limit in the ad account currency, or null to remove it.

name: ads_account_spend_limit_set
title: Set the ad account spending limit
